chase.ch_ndef: 追逐；追赶；追击〔某人或某物〕
chase.en_ndef: sb chases (after) sb/sth they run after them in order to catch them
examples: A pack of hounds chased the deer.
She saw a pretty dragonfly, and chased after it.
ch_examples: 一群猎犬追捕那头鹿。
她看见了一只美丽的蜻蜓，就追着它跑。

chase.ch_ndef: 追求；争取〔金钱；事业或成功等〕
chase.en_ndef: sb chases (after) sth such as money, career, or success they try hard to get or achieve it
chase.construction: sb chases (after) sth such as money, career, or success
examples: to chase (after) fame and profit/material possessions/pleasure
I know you chase that dream of yours, but it’s going to be no use doing it.
ch_examples: 追求名利/物质财富/享乐
我知道你追求你的梦想，但这样做是没用的。

chase.en_ndef: sb chases (after) sb they pursue someone for the sake of romance or sex
examples: He was too busy chasing every pretty girl he saw.
All he does is drink too much, gamble away any money he gets, and chase after women.
ch_examples: 他正忙着追求见到的每一位漂亮姑娘。
他只是成天喝酒，一有钱就去赌博，还老是玩女人。

chase.en_ndef: sb chases around/about they run or rush somewhere
examples: I chased around all day looking for a job.
ch_examples: 我为找工作奔波了一整天。

chase.ch_ndef: 向〔某人〕追讨或索要（钱、信息等）
chase.en_ndef: sb chases sb up they try to get in touch with them to seek something such as information or money
examples: Tom hasn't handed in his homework yet—you’d better chase him up.
ch_examples: 汤姆还没交作业呢，你最好催催他。

follow.en_ndef: follow sb to move behind them in the same direction
examples: You go first, I'll follow.
She followed behind her son, making sure he got to the school safely.
The others followed him into the dark room.
ch_examples: 你先走，我跟着。
她跟在儿子后边，确定他安全到达学校。
其他人跟着他进了暗室。

follow.en_ndef: sb such as a police officer follows sb else, they move behind or stay around in order to watch or catch that person
follow.construction: sb such as a police officer follows sb else,
examples: The policeman followed the thief until he stole another bike.
ch_examples: 警察一直跟着他，直到他又偷了一辆自行车。

follow.ch_ndef: （时间或顺序上）在〔某事〕后发生；接着
follow.en_ndef: follow sth to come after it in time or order
examples: The lunch will follow a brief business meeting.
The lightning was soon followed by/with thunder.
The debate was immediately followed by another one.
The speeches will follow shortly.
Further details about the meeting will follow in due course.
ch_examples: 一个简短的商务会议之后，是午餐时间。
闪电之后接着马上是雷鸣。
辩论一轮紧接着一轮。
演讲马上开始。
在适当的时候会给出更多会议详情。

follow.en_ndef: follow a road or river etc to go along it
follow.construction: follow a road or river etc
examples: She followed the river and finally found the source of the pollution.
I didn't follow my parents' path.
ch_examples: 她沿着河走，最后终于发现了污染的源头。
〖喻〗我没有走跟父母一样的路。

follow.ch_ndef: 听从〔建议等〕；遵循〔指令等〕；遵守〔规定等〕
follow.en_ndef: follow sth such as advice, an instruction, order, or rule to conform to it and obey it
follow.construction: follow sth such as advice, an instruction, order, or rule
examples: Follow the instructions on the label.按照标签上的使用说明去做。
Just follow your instinct.相信你的直觉吧。
I decided to follow the doctor's advice.我决定听取医生的意见。

follow.en_ndef: follow an example or fashion etc to act the same way as it
follow.construction: follow an example or fashion etc
examples: Why not try to follow her example and just relax?
She does not follow fashion like many girls.
ch_examples: 为什么不尝试像她那样放松一点呢？
她没像很多女孩那样去赶时髦。

follow.en_ndef: to take something as one's job or trade
examples: to follow a profession
ch_examples: 从事一项职业

follow.ch_ndef: 认真倾听，注视〔某人或某事〕
follow.en_ndef: follow sb/sth to watch or listen to them carefully
examples: The students are following every word of the teacher intently.
ch_examples: 学生们仔细听着老师讲的每一句话。

follow.ch_ndef: 听懂，明白〔某人观点或话语等〕
follow.en_ndef: follow sth such as sb’s opinion or words to understand it
follow.construction: follow sth such as sb’s opinion or words
examples: I couldn't follow his point at all.
I just don't follow because he speaks too fast.
ch_examples: 我根本不明白他的观点。
他说得太快了，我听不懂。

follow.ch_ndef: （因兴趣而）密切关注；连续观看〔电视节目；比赛等〕
follow.en_ndef: sb follows a television program or match etc, they pay close attention to it regularly because they are interested in it
follow.construction: sb follows a television program or match etc,
examples: The young man followed the tournament closely.
Many teenagers have been following the soap opera.
ch_examples: 年轻人密切关注着锦标赛的进程。
很多青少年都在追着看那部肥皂剧。

follow.ch_ndef: 边听人朗读边跟着阅读〔文章等〕；边听演奏边跟着唱〔乐谱〕
follow.en_ndef: sb follows a text or musical score etc, they read it while listening to the same text being spoken or the music being performed
follow.construction: sb follows a text or musical score etc,
examples: Follow the text while the teacher reads it out to you.
ch_examples: 看着课文，听老师给你们朗读。

follow.en_ndef: to happen as a result of another thing
examples: He died following a car accident.
There followed a long talk about religion between them.
ch_examples: 他死于一次意外车祸。
结果他们进行了一次有关宗教的长谈。

follow.en_ndef: to be a logical result of something
examples: You cannot predict all the consequences that follow from the fact.
Because something is important, it doesn't follow that we should require everyone to study it.
ch_examples: 你不可能预料到这件事情会产生的所有后果。
即便某样东西很重要，我们也不应该要求每一个人都去学习。

follow.en_ndef: follow a pattern or course etc to develop or happen in a particular way
follow.construction: follow a pattern or course etc
examples: Most exams follow the pattern of earlier years.
Unfortunately, developments did not follow the same course in the other countries.
ch_examples: 大多数的考试仍然沿用前些年的方式。
遗憾的是，其他国家的发展没有以同样的模式进行。

follow.en_ndef: sb follows a religion or a set of ideas, they believe in it and act as being guided by it
follow.construction: sb follows a religion or a set of ideas,
examples: A growing number of Africans follow Christianity.
ch_examples: 越来越多的非洲人信仰基督教。

follow.ch_ndef: （在电影或书中）描述（真人，真事）；演绎
follow.en_ndef: to describe a true story or a real person in a movie or book
examples: This documentary film follows scientists to Antarctica.
ch_examples: 这部记录片记录了到南极洲考察的科学家们的故事。

pursue.en_ndef: sb pursues sth such as a goal/an aim/an objective they continue doing it or trying to achieve it over a long period of time
pursue.construction: sb pursues sth such as a goal/an aim/an objective
examples: We pursue customer satisfaction with our products.
ch_examples: 我们追求客户对我们产品的满意。

pursue.en_ndef: sb pursues people or animals etc. they chase or follow them, in order to catch them, attack them etc.
pursue.construction: sb pursues people or animals etc.
examples: They went far into the forest to pursue the wounded bear.
ch_examples: 他们深入森林，追捕那只受伤的熊。

pursue.en_ndef: sb pursue sb they keep trying to persuade them to join in a relationship
examples: I was pleased, but somewhat embarrassed, when she pursued me.
ch_examples: 当她追求我的时候，我感到高兴，又有点尴尬。

charge.en_ndef: sb charges (sb/sth) some money for sth they ask the person for a particular amount of money for certain goods or services
charge.construction: sb charges (sb/sth) some money for sth
examples: They charged us an additional payment for shipment.
We charge a small fee for our service.
How much did he charge you for repairing the car?
From now on the museum will not charge for admission.
ch_examples: 他们又我方收取了额外的装载费用。
我们收少量的劳务费。
修车他收了你多少钱?
从现在开始，博物馆将不再收取入场费。

charge.ch_ndef: 〔某人〕起诉；指控；谴责；批评〔某人或其行为〕
charge.en_ndef: sb charges sb with sth or with doing sth they state that the person has done something wrong, or officially claim that the person is guilty of a crime
charge.construction: sb charges sb with sth or with doing sth
examples: The doctor has been charged with malpractice.
The ex-soldiers are charged with crimes against humanity.
Critics charged the writer with a lack of originality.
ch_examples: 这个医生被指控非法经营。
退伍士兵被控反人道主义。
评论家批评这位作家缺少独创性。

charge.en_ndef: charge sb with sth, or to do sth to ask them to be responsible for it
charge.construction: charge sb with sth, or to do sth
examples: The visitor centre charged him with the task of watching the young swimmers.
ch_examples: 游客中心让他负责看护年幼游泳者。

charge.ch_ndef: 〔某人向他人或某物〕冲锋，进攻；冲进〔某处〕
charge.en_ndef: sb charges into/down/at sb/sth they rush forward very fast, usu. in an attack
examples: The soldiers charged forward to seize the enemy's position.
Dogs were trained to charge at intruders.
He came charging into my office and demanded an explanation.
ch_examples: 士兵们发起冲锋，欲夺敌人的阵地。
狗被训练来攻击闯入者。
他冲进我的办公室，要求一个解释。

charge.en_ndef: sb charges sth such as a battery (up) they put electricity into it
charge.construction: sb charges sth such as a battery (up)
examples: When should we charge the battery (up)?
Does your car battery charge easily?
ch_examples: 什么时候给电池充电？
你那辆汽车的蓄电池容易充电吗？

charge.en_ndef: sb is charged with sth such as strong emotion or feelings they are filled with it
charge.construction: sb is charged with sth such as strong emotion or feelings
examples: His voice was untrained, but was charged with feeling.
The official is charged with ignorance and malice.
ch_examples: 他的音色并不纯熟，但充满感情。
这位官员充满了蔑视和恶意。

charge.ch_ndef: 给〔杯子〕斟满；倒满（酒或水等）
charge.en_ndef: sb charges a glass they fill it with wine or other liquids
examples: Charge your glasses and drink to their happiness.
ch_examples: 斟满酒祝他们幸福。

charge.en_ndef: sb charges a gun or piece of artillery etc (with gunpowder, bullets, or cannonballs etc） they load it (with that thing)
charge.construction: sb charges a gun or piece of artillery etc (with gunpowder, bullets, or cannonballs etc）
examples: to charge a firearm with ammunition
ch_examples: 往枪里装火药

charge.ch_ndef: 把〔某物〕记在〔某人帐上〕；赊购〔某物〕
charge.en_ndef: sb charges sth (up) (to sth, usu. one's account) they record the cost of it in an account so that they can pay for it later
charge.construction: sb charges sth (up) (to sth, usu. one's account)
examples: Please charge the wine (up) to our account.
I paid cash for the stockings but charged the new coat.
ch_examples: 请把这些酒记在我们帐上。
我买袜子付了现金但新外套是赊购的。

charge.en_ndef: sb charges sb up they make them excited
examples: He needs wine to charge himself up.
A good speaker should know how to charge up a crowd.
ch_examples: 他需要酒来使自己兴奋。
一位好的演说者应该知道如何鼓动听众。

run.en_ndef: sb runs they move by rapidly moving their legs up and down, faster than when walking
examples: She ran to her father and gave him a hug.
ch_examples: 她跑向父亲，给了他一个拥抱。

run.en_ndef: to cover a mentioned distance by running
examples: Jack ran two miles in under 10 minutes.
ch_examples: 杰克用了不到十分钟跑完了两英里。

run.en_ndef: （又作go running） to run as an exercise or sport
examples: All of us will go running tomorrow.
ch_examples: 我们所有人明天都会去跑步。

run.en_ndef: sb runs (in sth) they compete in a race
examples: Diana will be running in the 100 metres tomorrow.
He decided to run the marathon this year.
ch_examples: 戴安娜明天要参加100米赛跑。
他决定今年参加马拉松比赛。

run.en_ndef: (usu passive) to make a race occur
examples: The Triple Crown will be run over the next month.
The race will be run in spite of the rain.
ch_examples: 三冠王争夺将会在下月开始。
比赛将冒雨进行。

run.en_ndef: sth runs

run.ch_ndef: 经营〔商业〕；组织〔活动〕；管理〔组织或国家〕
run.en_ndef: run a business, activity, organization, or country to manage or control it
run.construction: run a business, activity, organization, or country
examples: She is able to run a hotel.
a state-run company
ch_examples: 她有能力经营旅店。
一家国营企业

run.en_ndef: sb runs a newspaper, magazine etc they print and publish it
run.construction: sb runs a newspaper, magazine etc
examples: We had to run our newspaper at a loss the first year.
ch_examples: 我们不得不在第一年亏损的情况下办报。

run.ch_ndef: 拥有；使用〔车辆或机器等〕
run.en_ndef: sb runs a vehicle or machine they own or operate it
run.construction: sb runs a vehicle or machine
examples: He can't afford to run a car on his salary.
ch_examples: 他的工资养不起汽车。

run.ch_ndef: 〔某人〕（使）运转；运行；操作〔引擎或机器等〕
run.en_ndef: sth runs an engine or machine it makes that thing go or function
run.construction: sth runs an engine or machine
examples: The washing machine is run by a small electric motor.
ch_examples: 洗衣机由一台小电动机驱动。

run.ch_ndef: 〔公交车或火车〕（按某路线）行驶
run.en_ndef: (of a bus or train) to travel on a regular route, or to make it travel this way
examples: Trains from Nanjing to Shanghai run every hour.
ch_examples: 从南京到上海的火车每小时发一趟。

run.en_ndef: sb runs sb they drive them to a place in a motor vehicle
examples: Shall I run you to school?
ch_examples: 我开车送你上学吧？

run.en_ndef: to go or move, esp. in a particular direction
examples: Would you like to run to the harbour to look at the ships?
ch_examples: 你想不想开车到码头看看船?

run.en_ndef: to make something move in a certain direction or manner
examples: She ran her fingers gently over the baby’s head.
ch_examples: 她用手指轻抚婴儿的脸。

run.ch_ndef: （使）导向；引导；（使) 伸展；延伸
run.en_ndef: to extend from one place to another, or to make something do this
examples: The power lines ran directly in front of the house.
He ran a cable from the lights to the stage.
ch_examples: 电线直接拉到了房子前面。
他拉了条灯光电缆到舞台上。

run.en_ndef: sb runs for sb/sth or sb runs in sth they compete as a candidate in an election
run.construction: sb runs for sb/sth or sb runs in sth
examples: He has decided to run for President.
ch_examples: 他决定竞选总统。

run.en_ndef: to travel a particular distance by running
examples: I lacked the stamina to run the whole length of the race.
ch_examples: 我没有跑全程的耐力。

run.ch_ndef: 迅速赶往；匆忙跑〔到另一处〕
run.en_ndef: to hurry from one place to another
examples: One should not run during a fire drill.
ch_examples: 消防演习时不可到处乱跑。

run.en_ndef: sb runs for sth they continue, function, operate, or are valid for a particular period of time
examples: The film has run for a month.
He was given two 12-month sentences to run concurrently.
ch_examples: 这部电影已连续放映了一个月。
他被处以两次12个月监禁，刑期同时执行。

run.ch_ndef: 走私；非法携运；秘密携带〔枪支；毒品等〕
run.en_ndef: sb runs sth such as guns, drugs etc they secretly and illegally bring, send, or take it into a country
run.construction: sb runs sth such as guns, drugs etc
examples: He ran guns across the border until he was captured.
ch_examples: 他在边境间走私枪支直到被捕。

run.ch_ndef: 〔叙述；陈述等〕有某样言词；内容等
run.en_ndef: (of a story or argument etc) to have a mentioned wording, content etc
examples: The story runs that she killed her husband.
ch_examples: 有报道说，她杀了丈夫。

run.en_ndef: a liquid runs it moves continuously
examples: Water is running down the walls.
ch_examples: 水正从墙上流下来。

run.en_ndef: sb runs sth for sb or sb runs sth they make liquid move continuously for a purpose
run.construction: sb runs sth for sb or sb runs sth
examples: Run some clean water through and then you'll see the true colour of the stone.
He ran the hot tap.
She'll run you a bath.
ch_examples: 清水冲刷过后，石头的真正颜色才能看出来。
他拧开热水龙头。
她去给你放洗澡水。

run.en_ndef: to send out liquid in a continuous movement
examples: The tap is running.
ch_examples: 水龙头在流水。

run.en_ndef: sb or part of sb runs with a liquid they are covered with it in motion
run.construction: sb or part of sb runs with a liquid
examples: The boy’s face was running with sweat.
Her back was running with blood.
ch_examples: 这个男孩满脸是汗。
她的背部满是血。

run.en_ndef: a colour runs it dissolves in water
examples: The pink of the towel ran during the laundry.
ch_examples: 粉红色毛巾在洗衣店褪了色。

run.en_ndef: (of a solid substance) to dissolve
examples: The ice began to run.
ch_examples: 冰开始融化了。

run.en_ndef: sth/sb runs at sth they are at or near a particular level
examples: The engine ran at a steady 60 km/h.
ch_examples: 发动机平稳运行时达到60千米/小时。

run.en_ndef: sb runs an item or a story they print, publish, or broadcast it
run.construction: sb runs an item or a story
examples: The editor decided not to run the story.
ch_examples: 编辑决定不刊载这篇报道。

run.en_ndef: sb runs a test or check on sth they try to see if it works or functions well
run.construction: sb runs a test or check on sth
examples: The doctors ran a test on his liver function.
ch_examples: 医生对他的肝功能进行检查。

run.en_ndef: tights or stockings run they have long narrow holes
examples: She noticed her stockings had run.
ch_examples: 她发现她的长筒袜脱丝了。

move.en_ndef: sb moves sb/sth, or sb moves they make them or it change their position from one place to another
move.construction: sb moves sb/sth, or sb moves
examples: He is going to move his furniture tomorrow.
I could hear someone moving around in the room above last night.
ch_examples: 他打算明天挪一下家具位置。
我昨晚听见楼上有人来回走动。

move.en_ndef: sb or an institution moves or sb moves to a place they go to live or work in a different place or they change their original location or place
move.construction: sb or an institution moves or sb moves to a place
examples: We are moving next week.
They are going to move to a new house next week.
ch_examples: 我们下星期搬家。
下星期他们将迁入新居。

move.en_ndef: move sb from sth, esp. a job to make them change a position to make them have another job position
move.construction: move sb from sth, esp. a job
examples: Yuvi was moved up from the manager post to the senior manager position.
ch_examples: 余维从经理升为高级经理。

move.en_ndef: a situation or process moves (on/ahead) it makes progress or it has improvement
examples: Unluckily, things are not moving as fast as we hoped.
Stock prices moved ahead yesterday.
ch_examples: 不幸的是，事情并未如我们所愿进展迅速。
股票价格昨天上涨了。

move.en_ndef: sth moves sb it causes them to have strong feelings, esp. sadness or sympathy
examples: The news moved him very much.
The story of the old woman's sufferings moved us deeply.
ch_examples: 这消息令他深受感动。
那个老妇人历经的苦难深深打动了我们。

move.en_ndef: sth/sb moves sb (to do sth) they cause them to do it because of or under the push of certain emotionsand feelings
examples: His deep love of music moved him to take  lessons.
ch_examples: 由于热爱音乐，他修了相关课程。

move.ch_ndef: 〔尤指会议上〕提出；提议〔建议；草案等〕
move.en_ndef: sb moves a motion, amendment, etc. they formally propose a suggestion concerning it usu. at a meeting
move.construction: sb moves a motion, amendment, etc.
examples: I move that the matter be discussed after lunch.
ch_examples: 我建议午饭后再讨论此事。

move.en_ndef: sth or sb moves sb else it/they change(s) their mind and decision
move.construction: sth or sb moves sb else
examples: The boss's made up her mind and nothing can move her.
ch_examples: 老板主意已定，绝不再变。

move.en_ndef: to take action to deal withsomething
examples: Unless the government move quickly, there will be a strike.
The company has moved to cut losses.
ch_examples: 政府若不尽快采取措施，就要发生罢工了。
公司已采取行动减少损失。

move.ch_ndef: （象棋等棋盘游戏中）〔某人〕下；走；移动〔棋子〕
move.en_ndef: sb moves a piece (in chess or other board games) they change the position of it
examples: to move a piece
It's your turn to move, please.
ch_examples: （下棋）走一棋子
轮到你走了。

fly.ch_ndef: 〔飞行器；鸟或昆虫等〕飞，飞行；飞翔
fly.en_ndef: sth such as an aircraft, bird, or insect flies, it moves through the air
fly.construction: sth such as an aircraft, bird, or insect flies,
examples: Overhead a plane flew.
A blackbird flew by with a twig in her beak.
The bee flew off as we approached.
ch_examples: 上空飞过一架飞机。
一只黑鸟飞过，嘴里叼着一根细小的枝条。
我们一靠近，蜜蜂就飞走了。

fly.en_ndef: sb flies (from/to a place), they travel there by plane
examples: She has just flown in from Huhhot and she is very tired.
She flew back to Beijing on Friday.
We are flying home this afternoon.
ch_examples: 她刚从呼和浩特坐飞机过来，因此非常累。
她周五乘飞机回到北京。
我们今天下午就飞回去。

fly.ch_ndef: 乘坐〔某航空公司〕的飞机
fly.en_ndef: sb flies an airline etc, they use it when travelling
examples: He always flies Air China.
I have never flown a first class.
ch_examples: 他总是乘坐中国国际航空公司的班机。
我从未坐过头等舱。

fly.ch_ndef: 乘飞行器飞越〔海洋；山脉或国家等〕
fly.en_ndef: fly a place such as an ocean, mountain, or country to cross it in an aircraft
fly.construction: fly a place such as an ocean, mountain, or country
examples: to fly the Pacific
ch_examples: 飞越太平洋

fly.en_ndef: sb flies an aircraft or kite etc, they operate it and move it through the air
fly.construction: sb flies an aircraft or kite etc,
examples: The pilot was flying the plane fairly close to the ground.
Kids are flying kites on the lawn.
Some rich men learn to fly.
ch_examples: 飞行员正在贴近地面飞行。
孩子们正在草坪上放风筝。
一些富人学着开飞机。

fly.ch_ndef: 升起，悬挂〔旗帜〕；〔旗帜〕飘扬
fly.en_ndef: sb flies a flag, or a flag flies, it is fixed to the top of a pole by someone and waves in the wind
fly.construction: sb flies a flag, or a flag flies,
examples: to fly the Chinese flag
He could also see another ship flying the Swedish flag in the east.
All flags in the nation were flying at half mast, mourning the death of the great man.
ch_examples: 升起中国国旗
他看到东边有另外一艘船也飘着瑞典国旗。
全国降半旗，向这位伟人致哀。

fly.ch_ndef: 空运〔人或货物〕；用飞机运送
fly.en_ndef: fly people or goods to transport them by plane
examples: The wounded will be flown home by air ambulance on Monday.
Fresh fruits are flown in daily to meet the local need.
ch_examples: 伤员将于周一通过空中救护车被送回家。
为了满足当地需求，每天都有新鲜水果被空运过来。

fly.ch_ndef: 快速移动；飞奔，疾行〔出/到/过某处〕
fly.en_ndef: sb/sth flies out/in/past, they move quickly
examples: The dog flew out through the front door.
She screamed as the ball flew past her.
ch_examples: 狗从前门飞奔出去。
球从她身旁飞过时，她尖声大叫。

fly.ch_ndef: 〔门；某人眼睛〕快速打开；突然打开；突然睁开
fly.en_ndef: a door or one's eyes fly open, they are opened suddenly
fly.construction: a door or one's eyes fly open,
examples: Her bedroom door flew open and she burst out.
Her eyes flew open in surprise.
ch_examples: 她的房门突然打开，她冲了出来。
她很吃惊，突然睁大了眼睛。

fly.en_ndef: time flies (by/past), it seems to pass very quickly
examples: How time flies!
The four years in college flew by.
ch_examples: 时间过得真快啊！
大学四年很快过去了。

fly.en_ndef: sth such as one's hair flies, it is blown and moves around freely in the wind
fly.construction: sth such as one's hair flies,
examples: She stands on the deck with her hair flying in the wind.
ch_examples: 她站在甲板上，头发随风飘扬。

fly.en_ndef: a rumour flies (about sb/sth), it is talked about by many people
examples: Rumours are flying that the president is to resign.
ch_examples: 总统即将辞职的谣言满天飞。

examples: He flew the country with all the money from the bank robbery.
ch_examples: 他带着从银行抢来的所有钱逃到国外去了。

abandon.ch_ndef: 〔某人〕舍弃〔汽车；房子等〕；离弃〔某地〕
abandon.en_ndef: sb abandons a car, house, place etc, they desert or leave it behind esp. because it is dangerous or no longer can be used
abandon.construction: sb abandons a car, house, place etc,
examples: The kidnapper abandoned his car in the northern suburb of the city.
The earthquake forced the residents to abandon their village.
They had to abandon their property to the invaders.
ch_examples: 绑匪把他的小车丢弃在城市北郊。
地震迫使村民们离弃了他们的村庄。
他们被迫丢弃财产，让入侵者占为己有。

abandon.en_ndef: sb abandons a person or animal etc, they stop supporting or caring for them
abandon.construction: sb abandons a person or animal etc,
examples: Tom was unwilling to abandon his  dog even when there wasn’t enough food to feed both of them.
The baby was abandoned to the care of strangers.
ch_examples: 即使没有足够的食物喂养它们，汤姆也不想丢弃他的狗。
婴儿被抛弃后，留给陌生人照顾。

abandon.en_ndef: sb abandons sth such as a plan, belief, or habit, they give it up for a long time or even forever
abandon.construction: sb abandons sth such as a plan, belief, or habit,
examples: to abandon a league game
to abandon the nuclear program
The company abandoned its recruitment plan because of the economic recession.
Strong beliefs in their labour union were abandoned when they accepted their employer’s offer.
ch_examples: 放弃联赛
放弃核计划
经济衰退使得该公司放弃了招聘计划。
当他们接受雇主的 提议是，这些工人不再相信工会了。

abandon.ch_ndef: 〔某人〕沉迷于〔享乐等〕；陷入〔绝望等〕
abandon.en_ndef: sb abandons themselves to sth such as pleasure, despair, or grief, they are mentally controlled by it
abandon.construction: sb abandons themselves to sth such as pleasure, despair, or grief,
examples: He didn’t abandon himself to pleasure even after he had much success in his business.
ch_examples: 即使生意做大后，他也没有放纵自己去享乐。

escape.ch_ndef: 〔某人从某地或某处〕逃离；溜走；逃脱〔监禁；搜查等〕
escape.en_ndef: sb escapes (from a place, person, custody, or unpleasant situation etc), they succeed in getting away from that place or person to gain freedom or safety etc
escape.construction: sb escapes (from a place, person, custody, or unpleasant situation etc),
examples: Barely two days later two criminals escaped from police custody.
Though he might escape from confinement, he could not escape from himself.
She escaped from reality into her own fantasy world.
The war criminal escaped to another country.
ch_examples: 仅仅过了两天，两名罪犯逃脱了警察的拘捕。
尽管他可以逃离囚禁，但他却无法超脱自己。
她逃离现实进入自己的幻想世界。
战犯逃往了另一个国家。

escape.ch_ndef: 〔某物〕被忽视；未被〔某人〕注意到；被遗忘
escape.en_ndef: sth escapes sb or sb's notice/attention/memory etc, they are not noticed or forgetten
escape.construction: sth escapes sb or sb's notice/attention/memory etc,
examples: Nothing escapes her.
The ant escaped my notice.
Her name escaped my memory for a moment.
ch_examples: 没有什么事情能够逃脱她的注意。
我没注意到那只蚂蚁。
我一时想不起她的名字。

escape.ch_ndef: 〔气体；液体；光或热等〕泄露；逸出
escape.en_ndef: sth such as gas, liquid, light,or heat escapes from /into/through sth, it comes out usu. through a hole or crack
escape.construction: sth such as gas, liquid, light,or heat escapes from /into/through sth,
examples: Water is escaping from the broken pipe.
Toxic waste is escaping into the river.
A bit of light escaped through the cracks.
ch_examples: 水从破裂的管子里冒了出来。
有毒废物排泄到河里。
缝隙中透出一点光线。

leave.en_ndef: sb leaves sb else or someplace, they go away from that person or place
leave.construction: sb leaves sb else or someplace,
examples: I think it's time for us to leave now.
He asked us to leave his office.
ch_examples: 我想我们该走了。
他要求我们离开他的办公室。

leave.ch_ndef: （永久）离开（如离家；离职；毕业等）
leave.en_ndef: sb leaves someplace such as home, company, school, they stop living, working or studying there permanently
leave.construction: sb leaves someplace such as home, company, school,
examples: She left home when she was 18.
He took up news writing after he left school.
ch_examples: 她18岁就从家里搬出来了。
他毕业后从事新闻写作。

leave.ch_ndef: 遗弃；抛弃（妻子；丈夫；伴侣等）
leave.en_ndef: sb leaves sb else usu. their partner, they stop living with or having a relationship with them
leave.construction: sb leaves sb else usu. their partner,
examples: Mary was always threatening to leave her boyfriend.
He left his wife for another woman.
ch_examples: 玛丽总是威胁她男朋友说要离开他。
他为了另一个女人抛弃了他的妻子。

leave.en_ndef: leave sth to not do or deal with it for the time being
examples: Leave the dishes--I'll wash them up when I’m free.
ch_examples: 盘子先搁着吧，等我有空的时候就洗。

leave.ch_ndef: 让〔某人或某物〕保留；处于〔某种状态;某地〕
leave.en_ndef: leave sb/sth in a particular condition, place etc to make or allow them or it to remain in that condition, place etc
leave.construction: leave sb/sth in a particular condition, place etc
examples: The dog got lost because the children left the door open when they got out.
She could leave the children alone at home without fear.
He left us waiting outside his office.
ch_examples: 那条狗走丢了，因为孩子们出去时把门开着。
她会毫不担心地把孩子单独留在家里。
他让我们在办公室外面等着。

leave.ch_ndef: 留下（某种结果）；造成（某种后果）
leave.en_ndef: sb/sth leaves sth or leave sb with sth or in a particular state, they or it brings that result or causes that consequence
leave.construction: sb/sth leaves sth or leave sb with sth or in a particular state,
examples: The red wine leaf a stain on my white coat.
The injury left him with a permanent limp.
The above-mentioned incidents left 66 dead and 20 injured.
ch_examples: 红酒在我的白大衣上留下了污渍。
那次受伤让他永远瘸了。
上述事件造成66人死亡，20人受伤。

leave.en_ndef: sb leave sth or have sth left, they do not use up it or keep it for future use
leave.construction: sb leave sth or have sth left,
examples: How many 15-dollar tickets do you have left?
He was not hungry, so he left half the food for the next day.
ch_examples: 你还剩多少张15美元的票?
他不饿，所以留了一半食物第二天吃。

leave.en_ndef: sb leave sth/sb in a certain place, they go away from that place without taking it or them with themselves usu. because they forget to take it
leave.construction: sb leave sth/sb in a certain place,
examples: I've left my bag on the plane.
ch_examples: 我把包落在飞机上了。

leave.en_ndef: to have a particular amount remaining after subtracting a smaller number from a bigger number
examples: Two from five leaves three.

leave.ch_ndef: （把某事）委托；交给（某人负责）；让（某人负责做某事）
leave.en_ndef: leave sth to/with sb; leave sb to do sth to allow them to take charge of it
leave.construction: leave sth to/with sb; leave sb to do sth
examples: Just leave it to me, and I'll make a good job of it.
we'd better leave her to make her own choice.
ch_examples: 交给我吧，我会把它做好的。
我们最好让她自己选择。

leave.en_ndef: sb leaves a wife, children etc, they have family remaining after their death
leave.construction: sb leaves a wife, children etc,
examples: He leaves his wife alone after the plane crash.
ch_examples: 他飞机失事后留下妻子一个人。

leave.en_ndef: sb leave sb else sth, they give it to them in a will
examples: She left her daughter $1 million.
ch_examples: 她留给女儿100万美元。

leave.en_ndef: sb leaves sb else sth such as message, note; sb leaves sth such as message, note for/with sb, they deliver it to them or put it somewhere for them to get it later
leave.construction: sb leaves sb else sth such as message, note; sb leaves sth such as message, note for/with sb,
examples: This note was left for you by Anna, who was here a moment ago.
ch_examples: 这张纸条是安娜留给你的，她刚才还在这儿。

advance.ch_ndef: 〔人群；士兵〕向〔某地；某人〕行进，前进；进攻
advance.en_ndef: troups or soldiers advance (on/towards) a place or person, they move forward to them/it usu. to attack
advance.construction: troups or soldiers advance (on/towards) a place or person,
examples: The troops started to advance at dawn.
The news came that a line of enemy tanks were advancing towards our position.
Our team has planned to advance 30 miles per hour in the desert.
ch_examples: 部队一大早就出发了。
消息传来，敌人的一列坦克正向我们的阵地袭来。
我们队已经计划好在沙漠里每小时前进30英里。

advance.ch_ndef: 取得〔技术等〕进步；发展〔经济；教育等〕；促进
advance.en_ndef: advance (in) sth such as the economy, technology, and education to (make it) improve or progress
advance.construction: advance (in) sth such as the economy, technology, and education
examples: The biotech industry has greatly advanced in recent years.
Recent theories advanced our knowledge of the universe.
The aim of her going abroad is to advance her studies.
ch_examples: 生物科技产业最近几年发展很快。
最近的理论提升了我们对宇宙的了解。
她出国的目的是提升学业。

advance.ch_ndef: 〔某人〕提出〔想法；计划；理论等〕；建议
advance.en_ndef: sb advances an idea, plan, suggestion, or theory etc, they put it forward for other people to discuss, comment, or use
advance.construction: sb advances an idea, plan, suggestion, or theory etc,
examples: She tried to advance a new theory in physics 10 years ago.
He advanced many reasonable proposals.
ch_examples: 10年前她就试图提出一种物理学新理论。
他提出了许多合理化建议。

advance.ch_ndef: 向〔某人〕预付〔款项〕；预付〔工资〕
advance.en_ndef: sb advances money to sb else, they pay them before the due date
advance.construction: sb advances money to sb else,
examples: The company could not advance any money to its sick workers.
You need to advance me a lot more than that.
ch_examples: 即使工人生病，这个公司也不会给他们预付工资。
你必须预付给我比那多得多的钱。

advance.ch_ndef: 〔某人〕将〔会议；聚会；考试等〕提前
advance.en_ndef: sb advances an event such as a meeting, party, or exam, they set a time ahead or make it happen earlier
advance.construction: sb advances an event such as a meeting, party, or exam,
examples: Our holiday trip had to be advanced by two days.
He rejected the idea of advancing his birthday party.
ch_examples: 我们的假期旅行提前了两天。
他拒绝把生日聚会提前。

advance.ch_ndef: 〔价格〕上涨；〔股票等〕升值；提高〔成本等〕
advance.en_ndef: sth such as the price or cost advances or is advanced, it rises
advance.construction: sth such as the price or cost advances or is advanced,
examples: The news that the stocks of the company would advance made him glad.
ch_examples: 公司的股票价格要涨的消息使他生开心。

advance.ch_ndef: 〔某人〕把〔钟表等〕往前调；把…时间调快了
advance.en_ndef: sb advances a watch or clock etc, they set its time ahead
advance.construction: sb advances a watch or clock etc,
examples: There is no hurry! Somebody advanced the clock.
He has a habit of advancing his digital watch five minutes.
ch_examples: 不用慌，有人把钟的时间调快了。
他习惯把他的电子表调快5分钟。

arrive.ch_ndef: 〔人或车辆〕抵达〔某地〕；到达〔某地〕（尤指旅途的终点)
arrive.en_ndef: a person or  vehicle arrives at a place, they get to the destination, or to the end of a trip
arrive.construction: a person or  vehicle arrives at a place,
examples: A whole crowd of us arrived at the party uninvited.
He became a citizen a few years after he arrived in America.
Finally, the police arrived on the scene.
ch_examples: 我们这一大批不速之客来到了聚会场所。
他在到达美国几年后成为了一名美国公民。
最后警察到达了现场。

arrive.en_ndef: sth arrives, it is brought or carried to a certain place
examples: The letter will arrive in seven days.
The package arrived intact.
ch_examples: 那封信将在七天以后送达。
包裹完好无损地到达。

arrive.ch_ndef: 〔尤指所盼望的事件〕发生；〔时刻〕来到
arrive.en_ndef: an event or moment, esp. an expected one, arrives, it comes
arrive.construction: an event or moment, esp. an expected one, arrives,
examples: The great day has arrived.
At last the great occasion arrived.
The craved victory arrived a week later.
ch_examples: 伟大的日子已经到来。
伟大的时刻终于来临了。
我们期盼的胜利在一周后实现了。

arrive.en_ndef: sth new arrives, it comes into existence or is ready for use
examples: Our new stock of autumn clothes will arrive soon.
The new product should arrive next week.
ch_examples: 我们的新款秋装很快就会到货。
新产品应该下周问世。

arrive.en_ndef: a baby arrives, it is born
examples: Has your sister's baby arrived yet?
ch_examples: 你妹妹的小孩出生了吗？

arrive.en_ndef: sb has arrived, they have succeeded or gained acceptance
examples: After he published his  bestseller, it was obvious he had arrived.
ch_examples: 在他的畅销书出版之后，他显然得到了认可。

come.en_ndef: to move or travel to where the speaker is located
examples: Did you come to Harbin the day before yesterday?
He invited many guests to come to his home for a sumptuous dinner.
ch_examples: 你是前天来到哈尔滨的吗？
他邀请了许多客人来他家出席豪华晚宴。

come.en_ndef: come a certain distance to move or travel in it
examples: People come hundreds of miles to see our display.
She has come a long way in her studies.
ch_examples: 人们跋涉了几百英里来看我们的展览。
她的学业已有了长足进展。

come.en_ndef: to occur or arrive in time
sb comes for/about sth, or to do sth they reach a particular place to get or do it
come.construction: sb comes for/about sth, or to do sth
examples: Many people came for drinks.
I've come about my share.
All the people from the surrounding villages come to help picking grapes.
My boyfriend told me to come swimming with him.
ch_examples: 许多人都来喝上一杯。
我是来拿我那一份的。
周围村子里的人都来帮着收葡萄。
我的男朋友让我来和他一起游泳。

come.ch_ndef: 位于；处于〔某位置或状态〕
come.en_ndef: to reach a particular position or state
examples: Your shoes came untied.
Your family must always come first.
Why don’t you come up to Hangzhou for a few days?
ch_examples: 你的鞋带没有系紧。
你的家庭必须始终放在第一位。
你怎么不到杭州来住几天？

come.ch_ndef: 达成〔某种决议；看法；结论〕；达到，进入〔终点〕
come.en_ndef: come to/into a decision, view, conclusion, or end to enter into a particular step or state
come.construction: come to/into a decision, view, conclusion, or end
examples: All our plans came to naught.
The army was disbanded when the war came to an end.
He came to the conclusion that he must work harder to succeed.
The new governor came to power under the banner of equal educational opportunity.
ch_examples: 我们的计划都落空了。
战争结束时军队便被解散了。
他得出结论是，要成功就必须更加努力。
新州长是打着人人享有平等教育机会的旗号上台的。

come.ch_ndef: 〔商品或产品〕被生产；被出售；买得到
come.en_ndef: sth such as goods or products comes in/with sth it is produced, sold, or available in a particular state
come.construction: sth such as goods or products comes in/with sth
examples: Toothpaste comes in a tube.
The bike does not come very expensive.
These pants come in several styles.
The model airplane kit came with clear instructions.
ch_examples: 牙膏装在软管中出售。
这个自行车不用太贵就能买到。
这些裤子有几种款式出售。
成套航模组件都附有清楚的使用说明出售。

come.en_ndef: to become or turn out to be
examples: He was given the chance to make his dream come true.
ch_examples: 他有了圆梦的机会。

come.ch_ndef: 达到〔对某事物认识，理解和相信的境界〕
come.en_ndef: sb comes to realize, understand, or believe sth they reach a state where they can do it
come.construction: sb comes to realize, understand, or believe sth
examples: I have come to realize the importance of family.
You will gradually come to understand the society.
ch_examples: 我意识到了家庭的重要性。
你会慢慢理解这个社会的。

come.en_ndef: sb comes sth (with sb else) they pretend to be it
examples: Don’t come the old soldier over me, because I won’t accept it!
ch_examples: 别在我面前摆老资格，我才不吃这一套呢！

come.en_ndef: come to some time to arrive at it
examples: We had come to a great moment of our lives.
ch_examples: 我们已经到了生命中的重要时刻。

come.en_ndef: to have an orgasm
sb comes across a person or a thing they meet them by accident
come.construction: sb comes across a person or a thing
examples: We've come across a lot of problems.
You may come across someone new that you have a lot in common with at a book club.
ch_examples: 我们遇到了很多的问题。
在读书会里，您有可能会遇到和您有许多共通点的新朋友。

come.en_ndef: sb comes across with sth they offer it
examples: Come across with the money!
After hours of questioning, the man suspected of kidnapping finally came across with the story.
ch_examples: 快把钱拿出来！
数小时的审讯后，绑架嫌疑人最终交代了作案的经过。

come.en_ndef: sb comes after sb else they follow or run after them
examples: Where are the people who came after you a moment ago?
ch_examples: 刚才跟随你的人去了哪里？

come.en_ndef: sb/sth comes along they appear or emerge
examples: She says she's waiting for the right man to come along.
ch_examples: 她说她等待着意中人的出现。

come.en_ndef: sb comes along they go together with others
examples: Do you want to come along?
Come along with me,you’re keeping everybody waiting.
ch_examples: 你想一起来吗？
孩子们跟我来，大家都在等你们呢。

come.en_ndef: sth comes along it becomes better
examples: Her skiing is coming along better.
ch_examples: 她的滑雪技术变得好些。

come.en_ndef: come along to hurry up
examples: Come along, it's getting late!
ch_examples: 快点，时间不早了！

come.en_ndef: sb comes around/round (to)
a date or regular event comes around it occurs again
come.construction: a date or regular event comes around
examples: The Mid-autumn Festival will soon come around.
ch_examples: 中秋节又快到来了。

come.en_ndef: sb comes at sb else they go to attack them
examples: He came at me with a blunt object.
ch_examples: 他用钝器向我进攻。

come.en_ndef: sb comes at a problem or question etc they consider it from a different angle
come.construction: sb comes at a problem or question etc
examples: He came at the dilemma by rephrasing the question.
ch_examples: 他重述问题来审视这个困境。
